data.data:
Join the discussion for a chance to win Oroberyl×500!


"Our fists know no regret, to live or die is the river's ways."

This is the code Mi Fu used to live by back in Qingbo Stockade, and it remains her consistent way of doing things to this day.

Her personality has always been just like her fist martial arts style: sharp, decisive, and never looking back. Yet when handling the daily, trivial matters of Wuling City, she reveals an unexpected side of iron-willed tenderness and meticulous patience.

From your initial meeting to fighting side by side now, what was your first impression of Mi Fu, and what are some of the most memorable moments you've shared during your time together?


▼ How to Participate

Head to the exclusive event channel and share your first impression of Mi Fu, or a memorable moment from your time together, to successfully participate in the event.


Participate Now: https://discord.gg/XFKFays656?event=1511647997870735510


▼ Event Rewards

From all Endministrators who successfully participate in the event, we will:

Randomly select 50 Endministrators to each receive Oroberyl×500


▼ Event Time

June 5, 2026 – June 20, 2026 at 23:59 (UTC+8)


▼ Event Rules

1. Before participating in this event, please ensure that you are of legal age in your country/region, or that you have obtained consent from a guardian.

2. All content must comply with the Discord Community Guidelines and Server Rules. Any violating content will be deemed an invalid entry, resulting in disqualification and removal.

3. Do not post any content that violates platform rules or is unrelated to the event (including but not limited to advertising links, and promotional materials). In the event that you're proven to have violated rules or undermined fairness in any way (including but not limited to the use of cheating/hacking software), we reserve the right to revoke your eligibility to participate and/or any prizes won. If considered necessary, you may also be prohibited from participating in any future events.

4. Please note: If your account is suspended or canceled between the start of the event and the winner announcement, or if you delete your post/comment made to participate during this period, we will have no way to confirm your eligibility and your participation will be deemed invalid.

5. Multiple submissions per account are allowed, but each account can receive at most one prize during this event.

6. For lucky draw events, the winning odds will vary based on the actual number of valid entries.

7. Winners will be announced on the official Discord server within 20 business days of the event's conclusion. Winners must fill out the prize information form within the specified timeframe to ensure successful reward delivery. Failure to complete the form before the deadline will be deemed forfeiture of the prize, and no replacement rewards will be issued.

8. If you win a virtual prize from this event, please redeem or claim it by the deadline stated in the winner announcement. If you miss the deadline, the prize will be considered forfeited.

9. In-game rewards will be distributed via in-game mail within 60 business days after the winners are announced. Please keep an eye on the winner announcement and your in-game mail to claim them promptly. Failure to claim the rewards before they expire will be deemed forfeiture of the rewards.

10. If the collection of any personal information is required for this event, it will be used solely for sending out prizes and any necessary communication with you. We strictly comply with all relevant laws and regulations, along with those set out in our Privacy Policy, to protect your personal information and ensure data security.

11. If you have any questions about this event, please contact the official Discord mod team via @Modmail. Gryphline reserves the right of final interpretation of this event to the extent permitted by law.
